Path B needs none of it: the admin mirrors a persona

When: after step 2, once the users exist.
Each persona consents once to each of the 5 OAuth connections: the first agent call
returns a consent link, valid about 10 min. Foundry then keeps the token 60-90 min, so
a role change reaches the agent only with the next token.
Apply the role baseline (step 14) first: a role-less first consent leaves the agent with
empty tool lists long after the roles are fixed (the token lives 60-90 min, the tool list
Three admin-portal switches: the Agent 365 gateway (the tenant-level consent),
Defender XDR 'Security for AI agents' and Purview 'DSPM for AI'. Click-paths:
docs\DEMO-GUIDE.md, section A6. Teardown does not reverse them.
When: optional, no fixed place in the order.
Start-JumpBox.bat starts the VM, opens its portal page and copies the admin password
for 120 s. Then Connect > Bastion, start the 'ABW Demo Console' desktop shortcut
and, on the first start, sign in once with a device code (az login) as the admin. Bastion
Developer allows one session at a time.
When: after the console (step 22) is installed on the VM.

Agents Behind the Wall - diagram 10 of 13 - generated by docs/diagrams/build_diagrams.py
Chip = the step id that -From, -Only, -Until and -Skip
take. Number = run order. Letters A-E = the
orchestrator's own phases. est. = planning minutes,
not a guarantee. Grey H = a human-only step (zone
below). White chip = operator-side tooling. Dashed
card = off by default. Default plan: steps 1-22.
-ResetState archives the local state and starts fresh;
status, time, attempts and a note, plus the last 50
runs and the verify result. Written atomically, never
Log, one per run, in infra\generated\logs:
Each step's own result file sits beside the state file.
1 = a required step failed, or a blocking problem
2 = done, but an optional step failed
Rerun the same command: finished steps are
skipped and the failed one is retried.
Also by hand: each persona signs in once to the Demo Console with a device code (it opens a private browser window and copies the code) before the 'Acting as' beats.
-WhatIf prints everything it would remove and deletes nothing. -Yes skips the type-the-resource-group-name prompt.
-KeepEntra skips 0 and 6, -SkipPurge skips 4, -CleanLocal adds 7. It only touches objects it can prove belong to the
- Each step's result is a file in infra\generated. A step starts only when the files it needs exist, a failed required step (1-17) stops the run, and rerunning the same command resumes where it
- The one command wraps the machine steps only. Persona MFA, OAuth consents, the admin-portal switches and the VM sign-in stay with people (grey H markers).
- Two ordering rules: create_agents.py runs twice, because the guardrail step (18) needs the guardrail that governance (17) creates; and the role baseline (14) must exist before the first OAuth
consent (H2). API Management (est. 35-50 min) dominates the run time.
